CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "league_country" AS WITH kv AS (
  SELECT id, attribute, value
  FROM table_1
  WHERE attribute IN ('name', 'country_id')
), pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(id AS INTEGER) AS league_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN attribute = 'name' THEN value END) AS league_name,
    CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN attribute = 'country_id' THEN value END) AS INTEGER) AS country_id
  FROM kv
  GROUP BY id
)
SELECT
  p.league_id,
  p.league_name,
  p.country_id,
  t2.mc AS country_name
FROM pivoted p
LEFT JOIN table_2 t2
  ON t2.sid = p.country_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "league_country" AS WITH kv AS (
  SELECT
    regexp_replace(id, '[^0-9-]', '') AS id_clean,
    attribute,
    value
  FROM table_1
  WHERE attribute IN ('name','country_id')
), pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    try_cast(id_clean AS BIGINT) AS league_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN attribute = 'name' THEN value END) AS league_name,
    try_cast(MAX(CASE WHEN attribute = 'country_id' THEN regexp_replace(value, '[^0-9-]', '') END) AS BIGINT) AS country_id
  FROM kv
  GROUP BY id_clean
)
SELECT
  p.league_id,
  p.league_name,
  p.country_id,
  t2.mc AS country_name
FROM pivoted p
LEFT JOIN table_2 t2
  ON t2.sid = p.country_id

FROM "league_country"
